title: Russia Aims to Inject Chaos Into Elections, U.S. Intelligence Finds

reports.title: Russia Aims to Inject Chaos Into Elections, U.S. Intelligence Finds

summary:
U.S. intelligence officials say Russia has again authorized covert online disinformation operations aimed at undermining public trust in November’s midterm elections. The Kremlin is using social media to spread divisive content and amplify domestic tensions, though officials found no evidence of attempts to compromise voting machines or the actual vote count. Some recent campaigns used artificial intelligence to create fake videos of Hollywood celebrities discussing competitive Senate races. The effort appears smaller and less coordinated than some past Russian operations.

Since 2016, Russia has run influence operations in every American federal election cycle, according to declassified assessments. U.S. spy agencies believe Moscow is less focused on midterms than presidential races and is distracted by the war in Ukraine. The activity comes as President Trump has repeatedly questioned election integrity, including a July address claiming severe vulnerabilities and that officials concealed foreign influence. The article does not specify what actions U.S. officials plan next.
